_doc: C2 WARN Watch seed — tranche 1, top-10 states by layoff volume (SPEC-01 C2). PRIMARY STATE SOURCES ONLY (aggregators are cross-checks, never sources — covenant). Each entry re-verified live with the collector's own http_get (DEFAULT_UA, HTTP 200) on 2026-07-28 (W-004). Cadence: daily, over-scheduled 2x/day (collect-warn.yml). Covenant: honest UA, one polite request per state per day, no auth/ToS/CAPTCHA surface, robots checked at onboarding. Formats are heterogeneous: raw is ALWAYS stored; `format` drives a best-effort notice-count in the manifest (parse completeness is per-state metadata, not a gate). Expansion to the remaining ~39 states is a gate item (new-source onboarding, SPEC-04). Deferred this tranche (walled/sourceless — see QUEUE gate warn-tranche1-walled-sources): OH (CMS serves 404 to non-browser fetches — needs a headless render), GA (no public list; employer-submission form only — needs open-records), NY current data (Tableau Public dashboard — the retired HTML table below is archived meanwhile).

states.notes: Live 'Detailed WARN Report' workbook, updated Tue+Thu. County-aggregated rows; dates are Excel serials.

FROZEN: this retired HTML table covers historical notices through ~early 2025 and is cleanly fetchable (preserving it is real archival value — it is marked retired). CURRENT NY data moved to a Tableau Public dashboard (dol.ny.gov/warn-dashboard) with no clean file export — deferred to a gate (warn-tranche1-walled-sources).
